messages:
Alex Chang: Heads-up — planning SGP staging cutover tomorrow 09:00 SGT. Main asks: KMS key ready? DNS records pushed? canary routing policy set?
Lina Kim: KMS key still with infra, pinged security 10m ago. expect key rotation window 08:30 SGT.
Maria Gonzalez: DNS change is in PR: `infra/dns#432` — needs one more approval. I can merge after Benji signs off.
Benji Patel: I'll review DNS PR now. Quick Q: do we use `sgp1.redwood-inference.net` or `sgp-staging.redwood` for the canary?
Alex Chang: Use `sgp-staging.redwood` for staging canary (consistent with other regions). I'll update playbook.
Samir Rao: Routing policy: draft is `policy/route-sgp-v2` — it's ready but hasn't been applied to the LB. @Benji can you confirm the LB certificate includes SAN for `sgp-staging.redwood`?
Benji Patel: cert has SANs for prod only. staging cert needs regen. Filing ticket #INF-987.
Lina Kim: If cert regen is needed, we need to ensure ACME hook works in the VPC. Security warned about rate limits last time. :grimacing:
Maria Gonzalez: Also data residency flag: customers with EU residency opt-in should not be routed to SGP. We need a routing rule: `if customer.residency == "EU" -> eu-region` — is that in the policy?
Samir Rao: Not yet. I can add residency predicate to `route-sgp-v2` and run unit tests. Will push changes by EOD.
Alex Chang: Great. Dependencies checklist: KMS ready (Lina), DNS merged & cert regen (Maria + Benji), routing predicate updated (Samir), canary config (me). Can we do canary at 5% traffic for 2 hours?
Benji Patel: 5% for 2 hours sounds good. I can automate rollback TTL in the canary job.
Lina Kim: Security: KMS key rotation scheduled 08:30 SGT, confirm by 08:20 if we need to delay.
deploy-bot: deploy started for `route-sgp-v2` canary (id: cb-2026-03-17).
Alex Chang: Nice — ping when the canary hits 200 requests so we can validate latency graphs.
Maria Gonzalez: Merged `infra/dns#432` — cert ticket #INF-987 created. :white_check_mark:
Benji Patel: cert regen complete and deployed to LB. :thumbsup:
Samir Rao: Residency predicate pushed and tests green. I'll open the rollout PR.
Alex Chang: Pull request for canary: `eng/platform#254` — requesting reviews from Lina and Benji.
Lina Kim: Reviewing now.
Benji Patel: Reviewed, left one small nit about healthcheck timeout.
Alex Chang: Fixed nit and replied. Setting canary window 5% x 2h. Starting at 09:00 SGT.
deploy-bot: canary update: traffic_at_percent=5, window=120m, status=running.
Maria Gonzalez: Ops note: customers with `residency:EU` should still route to `eu2` — verified rule in console.
Alex Chang: Thanks everyone. Post-mortem checklist: if rollback occurs, DNS revert + cert rollback + KMS rotation revert steps in `runbooks/sgp-cutover.md`. I'll add a short manual step list.
Benji Patel: I'll be on-call during the window. :eyes:
Samir Rao: I'll monitor traces and error budget.
Lina Kim: Security will stand by for KMS issues.
Alex Chang: Closing the loop — please react with :thumbsup: when you're good with the timeline.
Benji Patel: :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzalez: :thumbsup:
Samir Rao: :thumbsup:
Lina Kim: :thumbsup:
